Position Summary:
\r\n\r\n
The Authorization Specialist (AS) is assigned patients to obtain insurance to determine if an authorization is required for the testing/procedure being ordered by the requesting physician/practitioner.  The Authorization Specialist AS will check patient demographics and more importantly insurance information to ensure Conway Medical Center has the most up-to-date information for accurate reimbursement submission.    
\r\n\r\n

Qualifications

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • High School Diploma required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Two (2) years’ experience in hospital and/or physician billing/pre-authorization or insurance verification.
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Demonstrated knowledge of health insurance plans including: Medicare; Medicaid, HMO’s; and PPO’s required.
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Familiarity with electronic health records (E.H.R.) and documentation requirements and accessibility.
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Knowledge of online insurance eligibility and insurance verification systems.

Duties & Responsibilities:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Collaborates with designated clinical contacts that require escalation to peer-to-peer review.

  • Facilitates submission of clean claims and reduction in payer denials by adhering to both organizational and departmental policies and procedures and maintaining departmental productivity and quality goals.
    • \r\n\t
  • Educate and counsel patients on their insurance coverage and explain payment options that are available to them.
    • \r\n\t

    • \r\n\t

    • \r\n\t
  • Consistently display effective verbal and written communication skills.  
    • \r\n\t

Position Summary:
\r\n\r\n
 The Wound Care Nurse works collaboratively with the Wound Care Coordinator to support pressure injury prevention protocols, inpatient wound and ostomy consultations, staff education and events, quality improvement initiatives and regulatory compliance. This position serves as a clinical resource for bedside nursing staff while collaborating with physicians and interdisciplinary team members to implement evidence-based treatment plans. The Wound Care Nurse reviews clinical documentation for accuracy and completeness, validating pressure injury staging and Present on Admission status to meet CMS requirements. The position promotes best practices in wound care, skin integrity management, and pressure injury prevention efforts to improve patient outcomes and organizational performance.

\r\n\r\n
The Registered Nurse - Outpatient (RN) will be responsible for the care and treatment of patients in a medical office setting as directed by a physician. The RN is responsible for providing exemplary customer service and consistently practicing CMC’s core values of excellence, compassion, healing, teamwork, stewardship, innovation, and integrity.  
\r\n\r\n
 
\r\n\r\n
Qualifications: 
\r\n\r\n
 
\r\n\r\n
Education
\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Associate degree in nursing (ADN) required.  
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN) preferred. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n
Experience 
\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Minimum of two years’ current experience in nursing practice required. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Experience with Electronic Medical Record System preferred. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n
Licensure/Certification/Registration 
\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Current RN licensure in the state of South Carolina is required or in accordance with the compact state regulations.   
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n
 
\r\n\r\n
Duties & Responsibilities: 
\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Greet all patients and their accompanying family members when applicable and provide exemplary customer service.  
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Ensure that quality care is provided to all patients and is responsible for maintaining confidential records of vital statistics and other pertinent data.  
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Notify patients of diagnostic test results, ensure that clients receive appropriate follow-up care, and educate patients to assure understanding of physician’s orders effectively.   
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Perform duties including but not limited to rooming patients in a timely manner, recording nursing notes, vital signs, weight, etc., and coordinating care within the office team. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Provide and coordinate patient care, educate patients and the public about various health conditions, and provide advice and emotional support to patients and their families 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Work effectively and collaboratively with nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Effectively utilize strong organizational skills. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Consistently display effective verbal and written communication skills.   
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Proficient understanding and use of technology/PC skills required. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n\t
  • \r\n\t
    Remain calm and professional in all situations. 
    \r\n\t
    • \r\n

\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n

Position Summary:

\r\n\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Medical Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited to; administration of medications, blood products, performance of wound care, catheter care, tube feedings, IV therapy, tracheostomy care, and assist patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned. The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment. 

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Hospice and Palliative Care experience preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • ACLS certification preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Other:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational/time management skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Position Summary:
\r\n 
\r\nThe Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Endoscopy Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, monitor vital signs, perform the role of circulator and assistant with procedures and reprocess scopes. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, andassist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned.The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.  The RN must be willing to coordinate alternate housing within the facility in advance of shifts when inclement weather potential threatens the ability to get to the facility. The RN may be required to report back to work during any emergency situation i.e. mass casualty, internal disaster, etc. 
\r\n
\r\n
\r\nEducation:\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:
\r\n 

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • One (1) year acute care experience is preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Endoscopy and/or Operating Room experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nLicensure/Certification/Registration:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • ACLS certification required.
    • \r\n
\r\nOther:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required/time management skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t

\r\n
\r\n

Position Summary:

\r\n\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Emergency Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, care for trauma related patients and patients in need of critical care, monitor vital signs, suction patients, help patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care.  Experienced nurses may be asked to act as a team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned. The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.

\r\n\r\n

All organizational staff, including this position, are specifically required as a condition of continued employment to make advance preparations for their families and pets in the event of weather emergencies such as Hurricanes and flooding threats.  Any staff member can be determined as essential staff required to report to the facility during these events. In many cases this means reporting and sleeping at the facility before, during and after a weather emergency. By signing this job description, the staff member accepts this responsibility of readiness to report to work during any designated emergency staffing situation. CMC staff members operate as one team meeting the healthcare needs of our communities, thus this position will on occasion complete other duties as assigned beyond those designated in this primary job description which may include “float” coverage at an alternate facility, department or assignment.

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Emergency Department experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n\t
  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n\t
  • Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Other:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations.
    • \r\n
\r\n

\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n

Position Summary:

\r\n\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Emergency Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, care for trauma related patients and patients in need of critical care, monitor vital signs, suction patients, help patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care.  Experienced nurses may be asked to act as a team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned. The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.

\r\n\r\n

All organizational staff, including this position, are specifically required as a condition of continued employment to make advance preparations for their families and pets in the event of weather emergencies such as Hurricanes and flooding threats.  Any staff member can be determined as essential staff required to report to the facility during these events. In many cases this means reporting and sleeping at the facility before, during and after a weather emergency. By signing this job description, the staff member accepts this responsibility of readiness to report to work during any designated emergency staffing situation. CMC staff members operate as one team meeting the healthcare needs of our communities, thus this position will on occasion complete other duties as assigned beyond those designated in this primary job description which may include “float” coverage at an alternate facility, department or assignment.

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Emergency Department experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n\t
  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n\t
  • Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Other:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations.
    • \r\n

\r\n
\r\n

Position Summary:

\r\n\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Emergency Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, care for trauma related patients and patients in need of critical care, monitor vital signs, suction patients, help patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care.  Experienced nurses may be asked to act as a team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned. The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.

\r\n\r\n

All organizational staff, including this position, are specifically required as a condition of continued employment to make advance preparations for their families and pets in the event of weather emergencies such as Hurricanes and flooding threats.  Any staff member can be determined as essential staff required to report to the facility during these events. In many cases this means reporting and sleeping at the facility before, during and after a weather emergency. By signing this job description, the staff member accepts this responsibility of readiness to report to work during any designated emergency staffing situation. CMC staff members operate as one team meeting the healthcare needs of our communities, thus this position will on occasion complete other duties as assigned beyond those designated in this primary job description which may include “float” coverage at an alternate facility, department or assignment.

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Emergency Department experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n\t
  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n\t
  • Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Other:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations.
    • \r\n
\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Maternity Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, monitor vital signs, suction patients, and help patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, andassist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned.The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.
\r\n
\r\n
\r\nEducation:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nExperience:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Labor and Delivery and/or OB experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nLicensure/Certification/Registration:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n
\r\nOther:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations.

\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n

 

\r\n\r\n

Position Summary:

\r\n\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Radiology Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check peripheral IV’s, assess injectable ports prior to contrast administration, administer medications, monitor vital signs, suction patients, insert foleys and help patients with their personal needs. The RN will be responsible for informing the technologist or radiologist of any unusual patient need. The RN will perform specialized nursing duties such as administering IV moderate sedation or analgesia during special procedures and closely monitoring patients with cardiac/pulse oximeters. The RN will care for patients transported from intensive care, patients in emergency situations, pediatric patients and/or others needing moderate sedation as well teach patients and families about their tests and what to expect during and after test and orient new nurses to the Radiology Department.

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience required.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Radiology experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • ACLS certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Certified Radiology Nurse (CRN) by the Radiologic Nursing Certification Board (RNCB) preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • PALS certification preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Physical Requirements:

\r\n\r\n

Medium - While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently (activity or condition exists from 1/3 to 2/3 of the time) required to stand, sit, and walk; occasionally (activity or condition exists up to 1/3 of the time) to use hands, fingers; and frequently to talk or hear. The employee must exert 20 to 35 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 to 15 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Ability to hear to process instructions and safety code and alarms required.  The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job and will be assessed by post offer Employee Health fit-for-duty review.

\r\n
\r\n
\r\n

\r\n
\r\n
Position Summary:\r\n
 
\r\n\r\n
The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Maternity Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, monitor vital signs, suction patients, and help patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, andassist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned.The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.
\r\n
\r\nAll organizational staff, including this position, are specifically required as a condition of continued employment to make advance preparations for their families and pets in the event of weather emergencies such as Hurricanes and flooding threats.  Any staff member can be determined as essential staff required to report to the facility during these events. In many cases this means reporting and sleeping at the facility before, during and after a weather emergency. By signing this job description, the staff member accepts this responsibility of readiness to report to work during any designated emergency staffing situation. CMC staff members operate as one team meeting the healthcare needs of our communities, thus this position will on occasion complete other duties as assigned beyond those designated in this primary job description which may include “float” coverage at an alternate facility, department or assignment.      
\r\n
\r\n
\r\nEducation:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nExperience:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Labor and Delivery and/or OB experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nLicensure/Certification/Registration:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n
\r\nOther:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations.
    • \r\n
\r\nWorking Conditions:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Occasional exposure to difficult patients.
    • \r\n\t
  • Stress level high due to multiple demands frequently occurring simultaneously.
    • \r\n\t
  • Physical surroundings generally pleasant and comfortable.
    • \r\n\t
  • Frequent exposure to bio-hazardous materials.
    • \r\n\t
  • Prolonged standing and walking required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

 
\r\nPhysical Requirements:
\r\n
\r\nMedium - While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently (activity or condition exists from 1/3 to 2/3 of the time) required to stand, sit, and walk; occasionally (activity or condition exists up to 1/3 of the time) to use hands, fingers; and frequently to talk or hear. The employee must exert 20 to 35 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 to 15 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Ability to hear to process instructions and safety code and alarms required.  The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job and will be assessed by post offer Employee Health fit-for-duty review.
\r\n 
\r\n 
\r\n  
\r\n

Position Summary:

\r\n\r\n

The New Graduate Nurse Residency program partnered with Vizient™ provides a (12) twelve-month orientation to bridge the gap between academia into practice. The combination of classroom and clinical orientation supports the novice nurse in their development to proficiency.  Clinical and classroom orientation is facilitated by clinical nurse preceptors, Nurse Educators and Nurse Managers. The new graduate nurse will complete clinical orientation on their dedicated and hire unit. Hired unit opportunities include: Medical Unit, Surgical Unit, Maternal Child Health/Labor & Delivery, Critical Care Unit, Emergency Department, and CMC Operating Room. 

\r\n\r\n

Qualifications:

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associate degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelor’s degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina or compact state licensure as a Registered Nurse (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n\t
  • National Institute of Health Stroke Scale (NIH) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment. Required for all RNs on the Telemetry and Acute Rehab units along with charge RNs on other inpatient units.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Duties & Responsibilities:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Staff will interact with patients, family, and visitors using AIDET; engages others in the team to uphold standards in behavior; actively involved in process improvement activities.
    • \r\n\t
  • Consistently performs purposeful rounds on patients; completes care boards; responds to request in a timely manner; provides comfort and support to patients and families.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ensures completion of bedside shift report.
    • \r\n\t
  • Responsible for performing procedures such as those that are within the RNs scope of practice.
    • \r\n\t
  • Plan, provide, supervise, and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures.
    • \r\n\t
  • Utilize professional nursing judgment to individualize and prioritize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care.
    • \r\n\t
  • Delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care.
    • \r\n\t
  • Precepts others once qualifications are met and provides clinical guidance to students and ancillary staff.
    • \r\n\t
  • Act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned.
    • \r\n\t
  • Perform functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but the RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load, including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.
    • \r\n\t
  • Work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads.
    • \r\n\t
  • Effectively utilize strong organizational/time management skills.
    • \r\n\t
  • Consistently display effective verbal communication skills.
    • \r\n\t
  • Proficient understanding and use of technology/PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Formulates a plan for professional growth and development
    • \r\n\t
  • Participate in 75% of council, team and or unit meetings as posted and assigned.
    • \r\n\t
  • Demonstrate completion of expected competency, annual education and in-time education and as identified on time based on posted due date.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exercise independent judgement in emergency situations.
    • \r\n

\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
Position Summary:
\r\n\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Operating Room and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited to; administration of medications, blood products, performance of wound care, catheter care, tube feedings, IV therapy, tracheostomy care, and assist patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned. The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment. 

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Operating Room experience preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina or compact state licensure as a Registered Nurse (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • CNOR certification preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Other:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational/time management skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n

Position Summary:

\r\n\r\n

The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Medical Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited to; administration of medications, blood products, performance of wound care, catheter care, tube feedings, IV therapy, tracheostomy care, and assist patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned. The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment. 

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Hospice and Palliative Care experience preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • ACLS certification preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Other:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational/time management skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

\r\n
Position Summary:\r\n
 
\r\n\r\n
The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Maternity Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, monitor vital signs, suction patients, and help patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned.The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.
\r\n
\r\nEducation:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nExperience:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Labor and Delivery and/or OB experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nLicensure/Certification/Registration:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n
\r\nOther:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Position Summary:
\r\n 
\r\nThe Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Endoscopy Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, monitor vital signs, perform the role of circulator and assistant with procedures and reprocess scopes. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, andassist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned.The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment.  The RN must be willing to coordinate alternate housing within the facility in advance of shifts when inclement weather potential threatens the ability to get to the facility. The RN may be required to report back to work during any emergency situation i.e. mass casualty, internal disaster, etc. 
\r\n
\r\n
\r\nEducation:\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:
\r\n 

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • One (1) year acute care experience is preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Endoscopy and/or Operating Room experience is preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\nLicensure/Certification/Registration:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • ACLS certification required.
    • \r\n
\r\nOther:\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • The ability to rotate through the on-call schedule on a regular basis required.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational skills required/time management skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong verbal communication skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Ability to exercise independent judgement in emergency situations required.
    • \r\n

\r\n
\r\n
\r\n

\r\nINVITES YOU TO JOIN OUR FAMILY!!!!
\r\n
\r\n
\r\nConway Medical Center is a 210-bed acute care community hospital system located in the beautiful coastal Myrtle Beach, South Carolina region where we enjoy the sand and the sun all year.  The quality of living for every stage of life is uncomplicated and welcoming from the beach to the farm.  CMC welcomes staff from all over the world; some grew up vacationing in the Myrtle Beach area and others are first time residents discovering the low country style of living.  And to ensure you have the opportunity for work/life balance, we institute innovative staff scheduling to maximize work/life balance.  CMC offers very competitive wages with experience credit, and a comprehensive employee benefit plan. 
\r\n\r\n
Your future is bright at Conway Medical Center! Come join our CMC family, where we shine together, delivering quality healthcare to our growing community.
\r\n\r\n
Position Summary:
\r\n\r\n
The Registered Nurse (RN) will provide care of the patients in the Telemetry Department and will be responsible for performing procedures such as but not limited; start or check IV’s, administer medications, monitor vital signs, suction patients and help patients with their personal needs. The RN will plan, provide, supervise and document professional nursing care utilizing the nursing process for patients in accordance with physician orders and established policies and procedures. The RN will use professional nursing judgment to individualize the plan of care based on assessment of the patient's baseline needs and response to care, delegate tasks and supervise the activities of other licensed and unlicensed care providers, and assist other nursing personnel in the delivery of nursing care and act as team leader or charge nurse for a group of patients or an entire unit as assigned. The RN performs functions as noted above and generally with an assigned patient load, but RN is ready and willing to assist co-workers with ANY nursing support function and across any case load including other units that may not be the normal primary work assignment. 
\r\n\r\n

Qualifications:

\r\n\r\n

Education:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Associates’ degree (ASN) in Nursing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Bachelors’ degree (BSN) in Nursing preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Experience:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Two (2) years acute care experience preferred.
    • \r\n\t
  • One (1) year Critical Care experience preferred.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Licensure/Certification/Registration:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Current South Carolina (or compact state) licensure as RN (SCLLR) in good standing required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification must be obtained within six (6) months of employment.
    • \r\n
\r\n\r\n

Special Skills:

\r\n\r\n
    \r\n\t
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with co-workers, nursing colleagues, physicians, and department heads required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Exemplary core customer service skills strongly required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Knowledge of nursing theory and practice required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong organizational/time management skills required.
    • \r\n\t
  • Strong PC skills required.
